title: Untitled (Copy)
summary: A framed statement whose only original element is its signature; copying it re-signs the work to whoever copied it.
mechanism: The clipboard `copy` event is intercepted (clipboardData.setData + preventDefault) so every copy is re-authored to the copier; RAM-only ledger, no storage, no network.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
